prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1017; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a roadway in League City, Texas, when Driver 2 changed lanes into the same space and the two vehicles sideswiped one another. Driver 1 reported a concussion following the impact and was evaluated at the scene. The injury described is consistent with the type and force of the collision observed. Vehicle damage on both cars lines up with the contact points and direction of travel that the drivers described. Two independent witnesses, Driver 2, and photographs taken at the scene all confirm that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to the responding officer or reported by anyone at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Driver 1 was the only occupant of the vehicle at the time of impact, though the Passenger seat position relative to where Driver 1 was seated could not be fully clarified during the interview. The responding officer documented the scene and issued citations as appropriate.
